messages:
ajay: quick sanity check — after the prefetch-window change in PR #3481 I'm seeing increased eviction churn in the prefix KV cache on p3-canary. can someone run a short heatmap + hit-rate diff? observed ~3-5% drop on tail requests (latency-sensitive routes).

lina: which commit/region/shard? also do we have replay traces to repro?

ajay: commit 8f3b2c9 (linked in PR). canary is p3-eu-west-1 shard-7. no replay yet, just prometheus alerts + increased evict_count in logs.

simon: pinging the infra checklist — could be prefetch window too aggressive causing lots of cold eviction churn. run this quick prometheus query for the last 30m:```sum by (route) (rate(kv_prefix_evictions_total[30m])) / sum by (route) (rate(kv_prefix_lookups_total[30m]))``` gives evictions per lookup. also compare prefix_hit_ratio:```1 - (rate(kv_prefix_misses_total[30m]) / rate(kv_prefix_lookups_total[30m]))```

maria: i'll run a short benchmark on staging with canary flags. which workload should i replay? single-stream tail qps or mixed?

ajay: tail-heavy; 90/10 tail/interactive mix — use the tail set from /perf/inputs/tail-2026-02-28.json. ops: shard-7 config is here: ```/configs/prefix_cache/p3-eu-west-1/shard-7.yaml```

maria: running now. running kv profile w/ sampling enabled (`KV_PROFILE=1`) and 30s warmup + 5m run. i'll paste numbers. :hourglass:

ci-bot: deploy canary to p3-eu-west-1/shard-7 succeeded — image: inference-runtime:2026-03-16-8f3b2c9

maria: quick snapshot (staging run):
before (master): prefix_hit_ratio ~ 0.872, evictions/sec ~ 21.3
after (8f3b2c9): prefix_hit_ratio ~ 0.841, evictions/sec ~ 29.8
latency tail P99 increased from 112ms -> 134ms (simple tail workload)

simon: that delta is bigger than I expected. can you upload the flamegraph and the KV occupancy / fragmentation map? run:```curl -s 'http://staging-metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=kv_prefix_fragmentation_ratio' | jq .``` and also snapshot occupancy:```kubectl exec -n runtime svc/kv-inspector -- cat /var/lib/kv/occupancy.csv```

maria: uploaded flamegraph -> https://artifacts.internal/runtimes/fg-8f3b2c9.svg and occupancy CSV to the same bucket. fragmentation ratio spiked from 0.12 -> 0.27 for shard-7.

ajay: interesting — looks like prefetch is evicting more useful prefixes and increasing fragmentation. maybe window size picks prefixes that fragment across slabs. we should try reducing prefetch window by 25% and re-run.

simon: agree. also let's toggle the 'coalesce-prefetch' flag in config (it groups adjacent prefix requests). try both: coalesce=true and window=-25%. run small A/B for 10m each and compare prefix_hit_ratio and evictions/sec.

maria: queued two runs: run-A (coalesce=true, window=100ms), run-B (coalesce=false, window=75ms). will post metrics in ~25m.

ajay: thanks — if either fixes hit-rate without hurting throughput we can ship as hotfix. also open to a short-term fallback: if eviction/sec > 40 then switch to conservative prefetch policy (via routing policy).

lina: i'll draft the rollback + routing fallback config in a PR (draft) and tag you @ajay @simon.

maria: results: run-A -> hit_ratio 0.859, evictions/sec 24.1, tail P99 120ms. run-B -> hit_ratio 0.866, evictions/sec 22.0, tail P99 115ms. both better than the original but B looks better.

simon: nice. can you also check memory headroom? fragmentation may still be high; verify no OOMs and slab-rebalance didn't thrash.

maria: memory stable, no OOM. slab-rebalance events reduced in run-B.

ajay: conclusion: shrink prefetch window by 25% and keep coalesce=false for shard-7. open PR for config change and schedule canary rollout to prod with 1h monitor. i'll add eval hooks to check hit-ratio and evictions.

simon: add an automated alert: if prefix_hit_ratio drops > 2% vs baseline for 10m, escalate to eng-runtime on-call.

lina: PR draft: #3502, tagging reviewers. :white_check_mark:

ajay: awesome — thanks all. follow-ups: (1) investigate why fragmentation spiked (maybe allocation strategy), (2) add unit test around coalescing edge cases, (3) schedule a deeper profiling session next week.

maria: noted. i'll schedule profiling on Tuesday.

ci-bot: scheduled job `perf-run-1778001234` finished: artifacts -> https://artifacts.internal/perf/1778001234.zip

ajay: closing this thread for now, will reopen if regressions reappear. :v:
